name: 非凡夕阳MUD
group_note: 时空游侠录 (Roaming Swordsman)-lineage codebase, banner reads 非凡公子/新月传奇录II. No mudlib bugs found -- boots and plays cleanly under WASM with zero code changes needed. The one gate: get_id() requires the FIRST input after the id prompt to literally be the client-version string "shikongyouxia3.0" (a fixed magic-string check, not encrypted) before it asks for the real English id -- send that first or every registration attempt gets '你的客户端版本有问题' and disconnects. A stale libs/ffxymud/boot.log from an earlier native (non-WASM) driver run shows a real SIGTERM/'BUG: jumped out of event loop!' crash mid-session; did not reproduce under repeated WASM registration+look+score+quit passes, so left uninvestigated (native-only, out of this pass's WASM-playability scope). Formatter's blind-spot-3 CJK-respacing check caught two genuine corruptions (d/huashan/map.lpc, an ASCII-art zone map -- same shape as cctx's; d/player/fyue_room.lpc, a room description where the formatter's tokenizer lost sync) among ~25 false positives -- reverted both rather than hand-repairing. Also noted but NOT fixed: d/city/sj.lpc (an unreachable, unreferenced room -- no other file links to it) has pre-existing missing string quotes throughout (bareword Chinese text where string literals belong, e.g. add_action(do_out, out) instead of add_action("do_out", "out")) predating this project's conversion; would fail to compile if ever loaded, but never blocks the registration/gameplay/quit loop since nothing reaches it. Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist.
